description: Synthetic study-metadata documents with hand-written gold labels for all nine schema fields. Labels were written and checked line by line against each text by the author of this dataset; they are not clinically validated and contain no real data.
label_policy: Gold values use the normalized schema form (phase '1'-'4', participants integer, strings verbatim from the text without surrounding whitespace). A field is null when the text does not state an exact value.
